# DentalInsurance.com

> A+ rated comparison platform for dental insurance plans from major carriers including Delta Dental, Anthem, Cigna, MetLife, Guardian, and Humana.

DentalInsurance.com helps consumers compare dental insurance plans, get quotes, and understand coverage options across PPO, HMO, and specialized dental networks. The site features independent ratings from Trustpilot and Standard & Poor's, along with expert guidance from industry professionals like Kev Coleman and Shawn Patrick.

## Key Topics

- Dental Insurance Plans
- PPO Plans
- HMO Plans
- Plan Comparison
- Dental Networks

- Coverage Options
- Major Carriers (Delta Dental, Anthem, Cigna, MetLife, Guardian, Humana)
- Customer Reviews
- Dental Plan Quotes

## Plan Comparison & Quotes

- [Compare Dental Insurance - Web's A+ Rated Site for Dental Plans](https://www.dentalinsurance.com): Homepage with dental plan comparison, quotes, and customer reviews.
- [Get a Quote on plans in your area - DentalInsurance.com](https://www.dentalinsurance.com/static-census): Quote request and plan comparison tool for individual and family plans.
- [List of Dental Insurance Companies](https://www.dentalinsurance.com/coverage/dental-insurance-companies): Directory of major dental insurance providers and comparisons.
